name: p24_deepcenter_best_veto
title: Biohub P24 DeepCenter Best Veto
purpose: LEVER-0024 env-only A/B on the P9 champion: the public 0.927 lineage's DeepCenter bundle - the epoch-2 best.pt checkpoint (P10's selector) PLUS the safe-division veto switched ON at its default threshold 0.12. EXP-0023 showed the detection blend is not the 0.927 edge (FACT-0331); this is the residual explanation. Both knobs move together because the veto is only meaningful on a checkpoint whose heatmap is non-zero on unseen embryos (FACT-0311, FACT-0312). Everything else exactly P9. Pre-registered band 0.921-0.929, central 0.925; falsifier <= 0.925. Not launched or submitted by this spec (rule 8).

provenance.hypothesis: The 0.927 public lineage (arnav170/biohub-sdw60, teardown C:/temp/intel/arnav170_sdw60/REPORT.md) differs from P9 in its DeepCenter bundle: best.pt (epoch 2) and BIOHUB_DEEPCENTER_SAFE_DIV_VETO=1 (its cell3:34-39). With the deployed collapsed checkpoint the veto rejected every checked point (EXP-0008, FACT-0312), so the bundle has never been measured with a live prior on our lineage.

artifact.verification: Identical to p10_deepcenter_best.json: Kaggle dataset file listing, downloaded manifests, file SHA-256, and direct CPU torch.load inspection all agreed on 2026-08-24.

provenance.routes_on: a globally fixed checkpoint selector and a globally fixed boolean veto only; no dataset, crop, acquisition, hidden label, graph statistic, or image-content routing
provenance.interaction_warning: Two coupled changes by design, not one factor: the gap veto now accepts ~18% of checked synthetic gap points instead of 0% (FACT-0312), and the safe-division veto now rejects second-daughter candidates whose best.pt heatmap max in the +-1/+-2 window is below 0.12. The P10 one-factor arm (best.pt alone) was built and never submitted; if this A/B moves the LB, P10 is the follow-up that separates the two.
